title: People Over 65 Now Outnumber Children Under 5
hook: The world crossed from more young children to more older people.
closing: An older population changes who provides care, fills jobs, and supports families.
question: How will families adapt?

segments.say: People over 65 reached 705 million, exceeding children under 5. The global age balance had crossed.
The population over 65 is projected to reach 1.6 billion. The crossover is expected to keep widening.
People over 65 are projected to more than double the under-5 population. The world's age structure flips decisively older.
